headline: Brazil Releases R$ 950 Million to Install IBS Steering Committee
summary: The Brazilian federal government is releasing R$ 950 million to finance the initial installation and operation of the IBS Steering Committee, which will administer the new goods and services tax.
why: Tax reform implementation and administrative funding allocations impact compliance frameworks and operational structures for corporate taxpayers across Brazil.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Tax administration restructuring changes corporate compliance costs and consumption tax structures.
